company.name: VELAR
company.shortDescription: VELAR is a Multi-Feature DeFi App with Bitcoin Finality.
company.description: Velar is a fintech and blockchain company founded in 2023, focused on building decentralized finance (DeFi) infrastructure on the Bitcoin network. It provides a suite of applications—including a decentralized exchange (DEX), perpetual trading (PerpDEX), liquidity pools, staking, and a token launchpad—designed to unlock Bitcoin’s potential beyond simple transactions. Built on Bitcoin Layer-2 solutions like Stacks, Velar enables users to perform advanced financial activities such as token swaps, yield farming, and leveraged trading while benefiting from Bitcoin’s security and finality.
